model: Qwen3-Coder-30B-A3B-Instruct served by our own vLLM (bf16); the same weights in every arm. This loop changes only the harness, never the weights.
agent: Terminus 2 fork (terminus2_patches.agent:Terminus2Patched). The model replies in a JSON keystroke protocol. max_turns=100, a 15-minute time limit per task and context summarization are part of the evaluation protocol (frozen).
development_set: 74 synthetic training tasks in 6 families. Round 1 ran v0 with 4 attempts per task: pass rate 15.7%; 48 tasks never solved, 24 solved sometimes, 2 always solved.
evaluation_of_candidates: Each candidate runs at the same time as v0 on the development set, 4 attempts per task. Quality path: pass-rate gain with a 95% CI above 0 and at least 8 pp. Efficiency path: turns, input tokens or minutes at least 10% lower (each metric tested at alpha/3, and alpha is further divided by the number of candidates in the round), with the lower bound of the pass-rate CI no worse than -min(8 pp, 25% of the baseline pass rate), i.e. about -3.9 pp now; this path is closed if the share of submissions that fail rises by 8 pp or more. Reject: pass rate significantly lower, an always-solved task dropping to 0, cheating flags rising, or timeouts / cost rising without a quality gain. A second independent batch must confirm before anything is promoted.
round_1: v0 + append_nudge (a note telling the model to write a whole file in one command when it keeps appending lines with echo/printf >>) cut appending turns by 94%, total turns by 26% and input tokens by 31% with no detectable pass-rate change (+1.6 pp, CI -3.2 to +6.2). It was INCONCLUSIVE under the old give-up guard and is retested in this round alongside the new candidates; do not re-propose it.
failure_discovery: Two models independently read 80 failed development-set trajectories under v0. Most common: the agent declared the task complete although the result was wrong; in many of these, its own last comparison or check had already shown a mismatch or an error and it declared completion anyway or called the difference cosmetic. Also seen: building a program through many one-line append commands (addressed by append_nudge); getting stuck at an unfinished shell input; replacing an unfinished implementation with a placeholder. All other behaviors were rare (1 case each).
new_options: Besides the existing switches you may now propose text: custom_notes (one sentence attached to a fixed trigger from the menu in the scope table) and skills (a short how-to the model can open). A human reads and approves every text before it is evaluated.
this_round: At most one candidate from you will be evaluated, the first one in your ranking that passes the scope, text and duplicate checks. Rank carefully.
reserved_for_final_check: 37 held-out synthetic tasks and 30 Terminal-Bench tasks are never used to choose changes.
cost_note: Each extra arm in this round costs about 1.5 GPU hours (about 7 USD). Fewer, well-motivated candidates are better than many weak ones.
